children: Uniqlo's domestic fiscal 4Q growth could miss market expectations after a weaker-than-expected August sales print, Bernstein analysts say in a note. The Fast Retailing-owned clothing brand's Japan 4Q results are tracking 3.6% lower compared with a 0.8% growth consensus estimate, as July and August failed to fully offset weather-related weakness in June, they say. Japan all-store sales for Uniqlo declined 2.2% on year despite a higher average spend per customer, as customer traffic fell 10% on year, they add. They reckon the summer marked-down products failed to clear inventory, which leaves unsold stock heading into the season changeover. Bernstein maintains an outperform rating and 98,000 yen target price on Fast Retailing. Shares decline 1.2% to 70,400 yen. (megan.cheah@wsj.com)
